newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI modifies repos auction dates.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI modifies repos auction dates.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday said it partially modified the schedule of a repos auction announced for January 18, 1997.
RBI had earlier planned a three-day repos auction to be held on January 18, with payment on January 20 and repurchase on January 23, 1997.

"It has now been decided that the repos auction to be held on January 18 will be for a period of four days with the date of payment on January 20 as announced earlier, but with the date of repurchase on January 24, 1997," an RBI statement said.
The repos auction to be held on January 22 will be for a period of three days with the date of payment on January 24 and the date of repurchase on January 27, the RBI said.
